analysis.title: Kosmos Energy Ltd. (KOS): First Take: EBITDA Miss; Focus on Balance Sheet Management, Gulf Outlook, and Tortue Phase 1+ Progress
key_insights: KOS reported 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $0.06 vs GS estimate of $0.18 and FactSet consensus of $0.09. Adjusted EBITDA was $283.3mn vs GS estimate of $343.4mn, a $60.1mn miss.

4Q26 production guidance is 60-64 MBOE/d vs GS published estimate of ~75 MBOE/d. Management expects lower Gulf of America production next quarter due to planned maintenance, workover and storm disruptions.

Realized unhedged oil price was $88.57/bbl vs GS estimate of $98.67/bbl. Hedged realized price was $81.64/bbl vs GS estimate of $89.03/bbl. Net liquids sold were 3,786 MBbls vs GS estimate of 4,613 MBbls.
Ghana production averaged ~40.5 kboe/d net in 3Q. Jubilee averaged ~84.5 kboe/d gross, TEN averaged ~14.6 kboe/d gross, and the company reported 2.75 Jubilee cargo liftings.
Gulf of America production averaged ~14.1 kboe/d net in 3Q. GTA Phase 1 production averaged ~14.6 kboe/d net, with ~8.5 gross LNG cargoes lifted.

Management completed the 2025/26 Jubilee drilling campaign with seven successful infill wells. In September the partnership secured a rig for the 2027/28 drilling program of up to 10 wells, starting mid-2027.
The company completed the amendment and extension of its RBL facility and remains on track for a 20% reduction in net debt this year.
GS is Sell-rated on KOS with a 6-month DCF/M&A-based price target of $2.75 vs a $2.85 price, implying 3.5% downside. Key risks are commodity prices, capital spend and operational execution.

GS lists call questions on uses of cash and remaining maturities including 2028 maturities, Jubilee production trajectory, Gulf of America outlook and Trailblazer drilling, Tortue Phase 1+ progress and cost reduction models, and capital spend heading into next year.

market_movers.rationale: 3Q26 adjusted EPS of $0.06 missed GS estimate of $0.18, and 4Q26 production guidance of 60-64 MBOE/d is below GS ~75 MBOE/d. GS keeps Sell with a $2.75 6-month DCF/M&A target.
